name: pickup_assign_bvol_group_and_id
description: Pickup::AssignBvolGroupAndId finds the pickup bounding-volume child, parses type and suffix from the pickup node name, caches the type and pickup id in the node name overlay, updates the pickup type suffix maximum, disables the bvol child, and clears DI flag bit 0 recursively.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41db60 validates the bvol lookup, missing-bvol report/zero return, atol(name + 2), pickupTypeIndex = parsed / 100, suffix = parsed % 100, type-index upper bound of 40, stores at name offsets 0x1c and 0x18, g_NextPickupId increment, nameSuffixMax update, flag mask update, bvol deactivation, and recursive DI flag clear.
The native pickup leaf smoke verifies a successful pu1234/bvol setup updates type id, pickup id, next id, suffix max, flags, bvol active state, and DI flags, plus the missing-bvol zero-return path.
